lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, exhibiting a regular grid-like distribution posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating high-contrast grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient extending longitudinally across the upper and middle thirds of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs scattered across the leading and medial surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, pale vertical linear mark resembling a superficial scrape located between the first and second carinae, posterior to the gill region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (Echeneidae) exhibiting high-intensity silhouettes against the water column, positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin.
